The complete peak sequence supports the body-centered tetragonal cell (a = 5.80416 A, c = 11.59574 A) and Z = 2, and a read-only whole-profile reconstruction gives an unweighted Rwp of 0.0429 with profile RMS 0.129 versus off-peak noise RMS 0.100. The ordered tetrahedral framework has plausible Au-Se, In-Se, and Zn-Se distances and the required fully occupied Zn2InAuSe4 stoichiometry. Crucially, the trajectory explicitly instantiated all distinct cation permutations in lower-symmetry I-4 with independent Se x, y, and z coordinates: non-equivalent orderings fit dramatically worse, while the only competitive realization converged to x = y and was shown to be symmetry/origin equivalent to the submitted I-42m model. Thus the evidence supports the submitted symmetry, Se coordinates, and element ordering rather than only the cell or an average framework. Although the comparable-score report was unavailable, the trace and direct profile check leave no material unresolved discrete alternative warranting another attempt.
